result.summary: The page has a few visually broken elements: duplicate identical restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' section, a truncated restaurant name, and partial clipping of the bottom popular card by the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal list shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side-by-side with the same image and delivery time, making the list look duplicated or like placeholder content.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate entry or ensure the list renders unique restaurants/cards.

issues.description: The third item in the 'Fastest near you' list displays the restaurant name as 'Smash Bros Bu', which is truncated and the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis, wrap the title, or adjust the card width so the full restaurant name is visible.

issues.description: The bottom card in 'Popular right now' (pizza image) is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible padding, making the section feel cramped and clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or safe-area spacing below the last card so content is not obscured by the fixed navigation bar.
